delta.note: Tourism KLUs are kept in a separate set table filtered on sektor=pariwisata, valid for tax year 2025 so the year-scoped eligibility can read it, while Pasal 4A's October-December 2025 window for tourism is enforced in the period facility rule (replacing the deleted Pasal 2 ayat (3)). Pasal 5 ayat (5a) (refund of only the non-DTP part of over-withholding) already matches REG.DTP.REFUND, which now covers tourism employees through dtp_eligible.

output.reason: PMK 72/2025 amends PMK 10/2025 and extends the PPh 21 government-borne (DTP) incentive to employees of employers in the tourism sector (pariwisata), as listed by KLU in Lampiran A. For tourism employers the incentive covers Masa Pajak October–December 2025. It adds special rules allowing refund of the non-DTP part of excess withholding for permanent employees in tourism. It also confirms that footwear, textile, furniture and leather industries keep the January–December 2025 period. This changes a facility and its validity period for PPh 21 of permanent employees.
